name: Resend
summary: Email API for developers to send transactional and marketing email, with SDKs, webhooks, CLI and MCP.
description: Resend is an email sending platform built around a REST API and official SDKs. It covers transactional and marketing email: contacts, segments, broadcasts, automations and inbound mail via webhooks. Emails are written as React components with React Email; domains are verified with SPF/DKIM/DMARC and monitored for deliverability. Built for developers and product teams.
contains: send transactional email via POST /emails; batch up to 100 messages per request
marketing email: contacts, segments, broadcasts and recurring automations
inbound email via MX records and webhooks
React Email templates, CLI, SDKs and MCP server
test mode, domain verification (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), dedicated IPs and blocklist tracking
add-ons: extra domains $20/mo, dedicated IPs $30/mo, SSO $150/mo
free plan plus Pro, Scale and Enterprise
